display.purpose: Page titles and the dashboard greeting.

label.purpose: The single uppercase date label on the auth panel.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Content enters 6px upward on route change; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Hover and focus color transitions on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a screen; ink ground with clean-sheet text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-surface); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms linear; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supported action or navigation shortcut; rule border on clean sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 150ms linear; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with a quiet rule border and a teal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 15px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.44 0.08 195 / 0.15); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar row; active state is a clean sheet with a rule and a teal square.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--color-surface); border-color: var(--color-line); color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-dot { margin-left: auto; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Status Count
components.description: A dashboard status cell: 38px tabular number above a muted label, separated by rules.
components.css: .ds-stat { padding: 20px 24px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-stat-value { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 38px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-label { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: Docket looks like a ledger kept by someone who respects their own time: cool paper, dark ink, one stamp of teal, and a single persimmon mark when something is urgent. The interface is built from rules, margins, and aligned columns rather than cards and shadows. It should feel written in, not decorated.
keyCharacteristics: Cool pale sage canvas with white working surfaces.
Near-black ink text; teal used as a stamp, not a wash.
One-pixel rules and generous margins instead of shadows and cards.
Public Sans throughout, with tight display tracking and tabular numerals.
Flat at rest; only the mobile drawer lifts off the page.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Teal covers no more than about a tenth of any screen. It marks the active thing and then stops. Persimmon is stricter still: urgency or destruction, never decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change (task counts, due dates) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a section needs separation, add a rule and space. Do not add a card, a border radius, or a shadow to invent hierarchy.

dos: Do separate sections with a 1px --color-line rule and 32–48px of space.
Do use tabular numerals for every count and date.
Do keep body text at 4.5:1 or better and test against the actual canvas, not white.
Do keep the teal accent on the active thing only.
donts: Don't wrap sections in cards or nest cards.
Don't use gradients, glass, or decorative blur.
Don't put a one-sided accent bar on a rounded box.
Don't use monospace for labels, metadata, or technical flavor.
Don't put a kicker above a page heading.
